name: idle-p130
about: countdown-tick P-130: idle. One reload (the --inject logger installs right after it), then 128 s with no touch at the top, hero clock on screen, then one small 'still' up stroke (40 px, 600 ms) that gesture-run needs (it compiles no program without a stroke). The stroke comes after the logger's 120 s window and after its end grid read (121-122 s after the first change), so it touches nothing counted. The read follows the stroke, >= 126 s after the first change (>= 123 s required).
